---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or enhancement
title: "[FEATURE] "
labels: ["enhancement"]
assignees: ""
---

## Feature Description
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case / Motivation
Why is this feature needed? Who would benefit? Describe the problem it solves.

## Proposed Solution
How would you like this feature to work? Any specific API, CLI options, or behavior?

## Alternatives Considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional Context
Screenshots, mockups, examples, or references to similar features in other tools.

## Checklist
- [ ] This feature aligns with the project scope (educational, Turkish literacy, phonics-based)
- [ ] I'm willing to help implement this feature
- [ ] I've checked existing issues for duplicates
